# compute least-played song in Spotify song library
access_token='eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzcG90aWZ5K2dsZW5uLmJ1cnRvbkBnbWFpbC5jb20iLCJleHAiOjE2ODQ0MTIwOTh9.ZfYQhLH5HAUhTGeoP9Sil5Smkby8zvIfSpm2gzMvmWk'
# Reuse songs from previous run if available; otherwise fetch
try:
    songs
except NameError:
    songs=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        resp=apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
        if not resp:
            break
        songs.extend(resp)
        if len(resp)<page_limit:
            break
        page_index+=1

song_play=[]
for s in songs:
    song_id=s['song_id']
    info=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=song_id)
    # show_song details contain play_count
    song_play.append({'song_id':song_id,'title':info.get('title'), 'play_count':info.get('play_count')})

# Print all play counts for verification
song_play_sorted=sorted(song_play, key=lambda x: x['play_count'])
print('count',len(song_play_sorted))
print('least_played_first_10',[(x['song_id'],x['title'],x['play_count']) for x in song_play_sorted[:10]])
print('min_play_count',song_play_sorted[0]['play_count'])
# find all songs with min play_count (in case of ties)
min_pc=song_play_sorted[0]['play_count']
min_list=[x for x in song_play_sorted if x['play_count']==min_pc]
print('ties_with_min',[(x['song_id'],x['title'],x['play_count']) for x in min_list])
# Choose deterministic: if multiple ties, choose alphabetically by title
chosen=min(min_list, key=lambda x: (x['title'] or '', x['song_id']))
print('chosen',chosen)
